question:
(i) A dielectric of dielectric constant $K$ completely fills the space between the plates of a parallel plate capacitor. Obtain the expressions for electric field, potential difference and capacitance in terms of their values without dielectric.
(ii) A capacitor has capacitance $8\,\mu\text{F}$ in air and is charged to $100\text{ V}$. A dielectric of constant $5$ is inserted fully while the capacitor remains connected to the battery. Find the new capacitance and the charge on the capacitor.

options.A:
(i) For a fully inserted dielectric, $E=\frac{E_0}{K}$, $V=\frac{V_0}{K}$ and $C=KC_0$.
(ii) $C=40\,\mu\text{F}$ and, with battery connected, $Q=CV=4.0\times10^{-3}\,\text{C}$
